COLD_CHAIN_2_8.name: Chilled / Cold Chain (Rantai Dingin)

DEEP_FREEZE_MINUS_20.description: Deep freeze for frozen vaccines (e.g. OPV, varicella) and biological reagents.

ULTRA_COLD_MINUS_80.name: Ultra-Low Temperature (ULT)
ULTRA_COLD_MINUS_80.description: Ultra-cold storage for mRNA vaccines, viral vectors, and specialized biopharmaceuticals.

COOL_STORAGE_8_15.description: Cool storage conditions as prescribed by manufacturer packaging specifications.

CONTROLLED_ROOM_15_25.description: Ambient warehouse/dispensary storage for solid oral dosage forms and general pharmaceuticals.
